summary: Readers starting after a full WAL checkpoint held only a process-local database-file read lock and were invisible to other processes. Another process could checkpoint newer pages into the database file, violating the reader's snapshot. The fix registers these readers in a shared slot per process and limits checkpoint backfill while they remain active, without blocking WAL restarts. This reversal removes the database-file reader registration. The selected test was added by the fix and checks cross-process reader visibility and snapshot protection. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: a reader that bypasses the WAL must still be visible to other processes
